purpose: Test whether target reconstruction differences can preserve the published effect when static fractional deletion cannot.
budget: One target, <=600driver seconds, same existing model; no training/download.
statistics_unit: Paired verb/noun context families, development only
threshold_source_split: Four fixed published SFC Figure18 source features, selected before outputs
scope: Development writing diagnostic. Re-encoding uses all changed target codes and has greater writing capacity; it is not an equal-eight-member method comparison. Source-exact and target-reconstruction-read variants separate readout and writing.
